reason: azure_blob_client: PUT/GET/DELETE blob and List Blobs under one container. Scoped to the container, not the account: a data-plane role at account scope would also cover any other container that account later grows. NOTE that this is a DATA-plane role and is not implied by Owner — an operator with Owner on the subscription still cannot read a blob, which is the trap provision-object-persistence-container.sh's README records.
